# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old (at the end of Volume 4)  <sub>[v3 c28 P3](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0003), [v3 c28 P5](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c27 P8](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0008), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P8](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c7 P21](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0021), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003)</sub>; Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome, fair-complexioned boy with a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets all over his round head and dancing, roguish, hazel eyes. He has a dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs, a snub nose, and a wide, smiling mouth. As he grows older, he becomes stout, broad, and tall for his age.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P30](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0030), [v2 c2 P6](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0006), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008)_

## Personality

Davy is a lively, inquisitive, and mischievous boy who is constantly getting into trouble, though his actions stem more from a love of fun and an abundance of energy than malice. He is extremely curious about the world and is infamous for asking endless questions to satisfy his desire to know things. Highly impulsive and prone to doing things before thinking, he often feels remorse only after his pranks go wrong. Despite his mischievous streak, he has a sweet, affectionate, and warm-hearted nature that wins people over easily.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c10 P51](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0051), [v2 c10 P84](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0084), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

## History

Davy Keith and his twin sister Dora were orphaned when their mother Mary Keith died in East Grafton. As their uncle in British Columbia could not immediately take them, Marilla Cuthbert agreed to take the twins into Green Gables. Davy quickly established a reputation for chaotic mischief and endless questioning, testing the patience of Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde while developing a deep affection for Anne Shirley. Over time, his behavior gradually improved under Anne's gentle guidance and understanding, despite occasional pranks like trapping his sister in an outhouse, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, and stealing plum jam. Following the death of his uncle Richard Keith, a trust fund was provided for the twins, ensuring they would remain permanently at Green Gables. Davy eventually started attending Avonlea school, becoming close friends with Milty Boulter and engaging in typical boyhood rivalries and misadventures. As he grew older, he developed an interest in farming and continued to be a lively, loving presence at Green Gables.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c7 P25](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0025), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P60](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0060), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c28 P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v3 c22 P14](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0014)_
